newsitem.title: USA: Delia's IPO prices at $21 a share.
newsitem.headline: Delia's IPO prices at $21 a share.

text.p: Delia's Inc said on Tuesday that the public offering of two million shares of common stock priced at $21 a share.
Of the total, one million shares were offered by the company and one million shares were offered by selling stockholders, the company said.
Hambrecht & Quist LLC was the lead manager of the underwriting group and Oppenheimer & Co. and Montgomery Securities served as co-managers, Delia's said.
The marketer of casual apparel said proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, as well as funding for future acquisitions, if any.
